system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature, [Mnemonic Branch]

This branch of Kashu, focus more on the ancient art of traps and acoustics to overwhelm their enemies senses. Your Shinobi Instrument enables you to fight without your enemies even realizing they are at a disadvantage.

When facing you a trap is always waiting to be sprung. You use your Shinobi Instrument to set up a network of bells and sonic strings that turn the battlefield into your own killing choir.

Once per turn, while in combat, at the beginning of each of your turns you can place a Bell Wire at and point you can see within 30 feet. A Bell Wire is an invisible tripwire of sonic chakra that occupies a 10-foot radius centered on this chosen point. You can maintain up to 6 Bell Wires at a time. A Bell Wire is triggered when a hostile creatures moves through the radius. Placing additional Bell Wires beyond your maximum dismisses the oldest one.

When a creature triggers a Bell Wire, you can spend your reaction to cast any Kashu Hijutsu with the Auditory keyword targeting the triggering creature and dispel the placed Bell Wire. The jutsu originates from the triggered Bell Wire location. You do not need line of sight to the triggering creature. You are always aware if a hostile creature would trigger your Bell Wire.
